values.note: 2027 rates. Pre and post seasons (April 23-May 27, September 6-30): water/electric $35, full hook-up $40. Partial-program seasons (May 28-June 19, August 22-September 5): $50 / $55. Peak program season (June 20-August 21): $55 / $60. Off season (October 1-April 22): any site $20, no water and no services. Tent sites (no water or electric) $30-50. A week booked Sunday to Sunday gets one night free; 3% surcharge on card payments.

values.note: Booked on ResNexus. Registration for the next year's individual campsites opens December 1. 3 nights or fewer are paid in full at booking; 4+ nights take a 50% deposit. The 3-night minimum (Fri-Sun) applies on Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends.

note: Christian camp and retreat center near Rodney that runs a public family campground in four camping areas (about 150 sites by an earlier count, ~30 of them tent-only); natural grass sites, no concrete pads, three playgrounds and two lakes. In the peak season (late June to late August) a weekly program for families runs: horsemanship, target and adventure sports, crafts and the waterfront. --Claude
summary: Operator pages and its 2027 rate sheet confirm a public family campground (no membership or program enrolment; anyone books individual sites on ResNexus from December 1) with 30-amp water/electric and full hook-up sites, dump station, laundromat, store and WiFi. Fees recorded: $20 (off-season, any site) to $60 (peak full hook-up), W/E $35-55 by season; 3-night Memorial/Labor Day minimum. Season corrected to year-round (an off-season nightly rate is posted). Note cleaned of hookups, booking and the wrong 'seasonal Apr-Oct'. Phone 231-796-7669 matches.
flags: Price gate (informational): the base passes ($20 off-season, $35 pre/post-season water/electric), but in the peak program season (June 20-August 21) the cheapest site a 23-ft rig needs is $55 for water/electric (tent sites $50) - over US$50 then.

The website's family-campground and policies pages still carry a stale 2020 COVID closure banner ('Stay-At-Home order will remain in effect until May 28th') in their HTML alongside the current 2027 rate sheet; the campground is operating (2027 registration open).
